svg.title: One PoC story through the AI-native lane, phase by phase
svg.desc: Columns are the eight phases of one story, from populating Jira to release and Done. Rows are the components: humans, Jira, the orchestrator, the stage agents it spawns, the LLM, the PoC repository with its pull request, and GitHub Actions. Each phase shows which agent is spawned, what it produces, and where a human gate waits.
svg.text: ONE POC STORY THROUGH THE AI-NATIVE LANE · phase by phase

every agent below is spawned by ains-orchestrator as a headless Claude Code CLI process on the Max subscription; the orchestrator never calls a model itself. Human-lane stories skip the agents in 3–5 and join at 6.
JQL every 60 s finds the story
reads spec.md in the draft PR
PR ready → spawns the review agent
runs the tests · reads CI result
posts a PR review, never merges
GATE G1 · waits for Jira decision
GATE G2 · waits for Jira decision
GATE G3 · waits for PR approval

dashed = feedback or callback · dotted = audit trace · bold boxes = where an agent or the orchestrator acts · Human lane: the developer does phases 3–5 in VS Code + Claude Code CLI, then the same 6–8 (review agent on label ai-review)

blue dashed band = human gate where the platform waits (G1, G2 in Jira · G3 on the PR · G4, G5 in GitHub Environments). Gates can be switched off per target; a skipped gate is auto-passed with a Jira comment so the trace stays complete.
